subject: Exit with error when getRDB ftruncate fails (#3945)
reason: The change only alters valkey-cli's exit status (exit 1 instead of a silent exit 0) when ftruncate() fails while stripping the EOF marker from an RDB downloaded via the diskless-sync path in getRDB(). On the normal success path both builds are byte-for-byte identical. No installed fuzzer component can make ftruncate() fail on valkey-cli's own output file: it is a freshly-created regular file in the tool's writable working directory, shrunk to an always-valid in-range size, and the disk/deny-writes/partition faults apply to the deployment's servers (and need root), not to the valkey.action.tool
